title: 第9章 推演丹方第10章 吃惊的洛彦
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 姚德龙看着这堆战果，疲惫的脸上却满是亢奋的光芒。
索性也不睡了，直接揣起所有丹药。
连收拾都顾不上，再次风风火火地冲下了山！
万药斋。
洛彦正慵懒地斜靠在柜台后，翻看着一本账簿。
“洛管事！”
姚德龙的声音带着一丝急促和兴奋。
洛彦抬头，看着脸色有些苍白却眼神发亮的姚德龙，柳眉微蹙心想；
“昨日才来购买药材，今天怎么又跑来了？”
“姚道友？你……”
姚德龙也不废话，直接从怀里掏出一个小玉瓶，拔开塞子，递到洛彦面前。
一股精纯至极、远超普通品质的灵力波动瞬间弥漫开来！
洛彦慵懒的神情瞬间凝固！
她猛地坐直身体，一双妩媚的杏眼死死盯着瓶中那碧绿如玉、丹纹流转的丹药
娇躯不受控制地微微一颤！
她甚至失态地一把夺过玉瓶，倒出一颗仔细端详，指尖微微颤抖！
“完……完美品质的回灵丹？”
她的声音带着难以置信的惊骇！
完美品质！
这意味着一颗丹药几乎蕴含了所能达到的最极致药力，杂质微乎其微！
这绝不是普通一品炼丹师能做到的！
至少需要二品，甚至接近三品的大师级掌控力，才有可能！
但是哪个二品以上的炼丹师会浪费时间炼制这种低阶丹药？
她猛地抬头，目光锐利如刀，直射姚德龙那张苍老枯槁的脸：
“姚道友！
这……这是你炼的？！”
她的语气充满了极度的怀疑和震惊。
姚德龙微微一笑，带着故作的淡然和一丝不易察觉的得意：
“呵呵，侥幸，侥幸而已。
昨夜回去心有所感。
便尝试了一下，没想到……还真成了几炉！”
几炉？！
洛彦的心跳猛的一急！
她深吸一口气，强压下心头的惊涛骇浪，脸上重新堆起商人精明的笑容；
“姚道友真人不露相啊！
深藏不露！
content_en:
Yao Delong looked at the pile of victory results, but his tired face was filled with excitement.
He simply stopped sleeping and picked up all the elixirs.
Not even bothering to clean up, he rushed down the mountain in a hurry again!
Wanyaozhai.
Luo Yan was leaning lazily behind the counter, flipping through an account book.
"Guanshi Luo!"
Yao Delong's voice was full of urgency and excitement.
Luo Yan raised his head and looked at Yao Delong, who was a little pale but had bright eyes, and thought with a slight frown on his eyebrows;
"I just came here yesterday to buy medicinal materials. Why are you here again today?"
"Fellow Daoist Yao? You..."
Yao Delong didn't waste any time and took out a small jade bottle from his arms, uncorked it and handed it to Luo Yan.
A wave of extremely pure spiritual power that far exceeded ordinary quality spread instantly!
Luo Yan's lazy expression froze instantly!
She sat upright suddenly, her charming almond eyes staring intently at the jade-green elixir with flowing elixir patterns in the bottle.
Her delicate body trembled uncontrollably!
She even lost her composure and grabbed the jade bottle, poured one out and looked at it carefully, her fingertips trembling slightly!
"Complete...a perfect quality spirit-rejuvenating elixir?"
Her voice was filled with incredible horror!
Perfect quality!
This means that a pill almost contains the most extreme medicinal power possible, with very little impurities!
This is definitely not something that an ordinary first-grade alchemist can do!
It requires at least second-grade, or even close to third-grade master-level control to be possible!
But which second-level alchemist or above would waste time refining such a low-level elixir?
She raised her head suddenly, her gaze as sharp as a knife, directed at Yao Delong's old and withered face:
"Fellow Daoist Yao!
This...you practiced this? ! "
Her tone was full of extreme disbelief and shock.
Yao Delong smiled slightly, with a pretentious indifference and a hint of imperceptible pride:
“Haha, it’s a fluke, it’s just a fluke.
I felt something when I went back last night.
So I tried it, and to my surprise... it actually turned out to be several! "
How many furnaces? !
Luo Yan's heart beat rapidly!
She took a deep breath, suppressed the turmoil in her heart, and regained the shrewd smile of a businessman on her face;
"Yao Daoyou really doesn't show his face!
Hidden and hidden!
title_en: Chapter 9 Deduction of Danfang Chapter 10 Surprised Luo Yan
